title: Extension web pane: a customize-folder extension whose pane is its own HTML page (render: web), shown in a tab and reloaded in place when its files are saved

steps.title: A workspace whose terminal writes the extension
Shell helpers: the customize folder, a page writer and a manifest writer
Install: web/index.html, web/page.css, then cmux-app.json, into the customize folder
cmux: css > "$D/web/page.css"; pg 'Web pane: first page' > "$D/web/index.html"; mf > "$D/cmux-app.json"; clear

steps.title: Open the extension's pane: its page renders in a tab
Save: rewrite web/index.html in place; the open page reloads
cmux: pg 'Web pane: saved, reloaded in place' > "$D/web/index.html"
